info.title: DataScope Forms Universal API
info.description: Access DataScope form answers, metadata, locations, lists, task assignments, notifications, and generated files through the public DataScope API.

put.description: Updates list elements in DataScope Forms by replacing the full list.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

list_objects[].description: Array of list objects to create or update. Objects not present may be soft-deleted by DataScope.

metadata_type.description: Internal code that identifies the list to replace.

name.description: Name of the list to create or update.

get.description: Retrieves a list element from DataScope Forms.

parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.description: Internal identifier of the list element to fetch.

schema.description: Internal identifier of the list element to fetch.

parameters.name: metadataType
parameters.description: Internal code that identifies the target list.

schema.description: Internal code that identifies the target list.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

attribute1.description: Custom attribute 1 of the list element.

attribute2.description: Custom attribute 2 of the list element.

created_at.description: Date when the list element was created.

id.description: Internal identifier of the list element.

list_id.description: Internal identifier of the parent list.

updated_at.description: Date when the list element was updated.

get.description: Retrieves submitted answers from DataScope Forms.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: formId
parameters.description: Filter answers to a specific DataScope form.

schema.description: Filter answers to a specific DataScope form.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Filter answers to a specific user.

schema.description: Filter answers to a specific user.

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: Start of the date range to fetch answers for.

schema.description: Start of the date range to fetch answers for.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: End of the date range to fetch answers for.

schema.description: End of the date range to fetch answers for.

parameters.name: locationId
parameters.description: Filter answers to a specific location.

schema.description: Filter answers to a specific location.

parameters.name: dateModified
parameters.description: Use the answer modification date instead of the creation date when filtering.

schema.description: Use the answer modification date instead of the creation date when filtering.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

code.description: Public identifier returned in the DataScope example payload.

form_answer_id.description: Internal code of the form answer.

form_state.description: Last status of the form answer.

latitude.description: Latitude where the form was answered.

longitude.description: Longitude where the form was answered.

user_identifier.description: Identifier of the user who submitted the form.
